review:
Dragon's Domain is a 6x5 scatter-pays cascade slot with knights, treasure and Charred Land wild multipliers. Each one lands with three charges and a value of 2x to 10x. It loses a charge after each win it joins but gains +1x every time the grid cascades, so a wild can grow quite a bit during a long chain.

Several Charred Lands in the same win add their values together, and Dragon symbols breathe Dragonfire across the board to create more of them. There are two bonus games, and the cap is 10,000x. The charge system is a neat way to make wild multipliers both grow and expire.
